# MileCheck

MileCheck is a mobile app for iOS and Android that shows your nearest highway mile marker in real time, along with live road conditions, traffic cameras, and incident alerts from state departments of transportation across the United States (and now Canada).

## Key facts

- Coverage: mile markers in all 50 US states and kilometre markers in 10 Canadian provinces. Live state DOT feeds in all 50 states plus British Columbia, Alberta and Manitoba (as of September 2026). Live traffic cameras in 27 states and 3 provinces, 51,000+ cameras.
- Price: Free tier (mile markers only). Premium $19.99/year or $4.99/month — 2-week free trial. Existing subscribers keep the price they signed up at.
- Platforms: iOS (App Store, ID 6759212851) and Android (Google Play, package app.milecheck.mobile).
- CarPlay and Android Auto: both live. The in-dash screen shows the nearest mile marker and is free for everyone.

## What it does

- Shows the nearest highway mile marker with interpolated decimal position (e.g., "MP 142.4 on I-5 NB").
- Provides live road alerts: closures, crashes, construction, weather conditions, chain requirements, and bridge status.
- Shows live DOT traffic cameras on an interactive map — the actual road, updated continuously.
- Pulls from 50 state DOT feeds plus three Canadian provinces, updated in real time, normalizing many distinct upstream platform formats into one schema.
- Lets users navigate to any specific milepost by typing a route and mile number (e.g., "I-5 MP 200").
- Tracks Seattle drawbridge status with live open/closed state for the Ballard, Fremont, Montlake, South Park, and 1st Ave S bridges.
- Shows border crossing wait times for US/Canada and US/Mexico ports of entry.
- Records trips with route, milepost range, start/end times, direction, and notes. Exports as CSV.
- Works fully offline using bundled milepost data for all 50 states.
- Shows weather from the National Weather Service (temperature, conditions, wind, sunrise/sunset), plus a crosswind warning for high-profile vehicles.

## Who uses it

- DOT field crews and emergency response teams (EMTs, incident command) who report position by milepost.
- Truck drivers and commercial vehicle operators needing precise milepost location for dispatch and logging.
- Road trip travelers and commuters who want to know exactly where they are on the highway.
- Highway maintenance workers logging which miles they treated or patrolled.
- Anyone stranded on a highway who needs to tell 911 or a tow truck their exact location.

## Technical architecture

- Cloudflare Worker (milepost-proxy) normalizes many distinct DOT API formats into a unified schema.
- 200,000+ pre-computed milepost coordinates bundled in the app for offline-first operation.
- Three-tier cache: in-memory → AsyncStorage → bundled fallback.
- Stack: React Native, Expo SDK 55, TypeScript, Google Maps SDK.
- Crash telemetry via Sentry. Subscriptions via RevenueCat.

## Mountain Visibility Forecast (a second app from MileCheck LLC)

- What it does: reads whether a big mountain can be seen today from a nearby town, and the next five days, from airport weather, cloud and haze data along the sightline. A visibility forecast, not a safety guarantee.
- Mountains: Rainier, Hood, Baker, St. Helens, Denali, the Olympics (Mount Constance), Mount Angeles, Mount Baldy.
- Price: $1.99 once on iOS and Android. No subscription, no in-app purchases.
- Mountain pages and viewpoints: https://milecheckapp.com/mountains/
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6810003955
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.milecheck.rainier
- Contact: mountains@milecheckapp.com
